local function JSXEYO_script() 
	local script = Instance.new('LocalScript', Frame)

	local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
	
	local gui = script.Parent
	
	local dragging
	local dragInput
	local dragStart
	local startPos
	
	local function update(input)
		local delta = input.Position - dragStart
		gui.Position = UDim2.new(startPos.X.Scale, startPos.X.Offset + delta.X, startPos.Y.Scale, startPos.Y.Offset + delta.Y)
	end
	
	gui.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
		if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
			dragging = true
			dragStart = input.Position
			startPos = gui.Position
			
			input.Changed:Connect(function()
				if input.UserInputState == Enum.UserInputState.End then
					dragging = false
				end
			end)
		end
	end)
	
	gui.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
		if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
			dragInput = input
		end
	end)
	
	UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
		if input == dragInput and dragging then
			update(input)
		end
	end)
end

local function MGKHHR_script() 
	local script = Instance.new('LocalScript', Name_3)

	local Players = game:GetService("Players")
	local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
	local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
	
	local player = Players.LocalPlayer
	local character = player.Character or player.CharacterAdded:Wait()
	local humanoid = character:WaitForChild("Humanoid")
	local rootPart = character:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	
	local button = script.Parent
	local originalColor = button.BackgroundColor3
	local activeColor = Color3.new(0.341176, 0.45098, 0.294118)
	
	local isFlying = false
	local flightConnection = nil
	local originalTransparency = {}
	
	local function saveTransparency()
		originalTransparency = {}
		for _, part in pairs(character:GetDescendants()) do
			if part:IsA("BasePart") then
				originalTransparency[part] = part.Transparency
			end
		end
	end
	
	local function setTransparency(value)
		for part, _ in pairs(originalTransparency) do
			if part and part.Parent then
				part.Transparency = value
			end
		end
	end
	
	local function restoreTransparency()
		for part, originalValue in pairs(originalTransparency) do
			if part and part.Parent then
				part.Transparency = originalValue
			end
		end
	end
	
	local function stopFlying()
		if flightConnection then
			flightConnection:Disconnect()
			flightConnection = nil
		end
	
		restoreTransparency()
		humanoid.PlatformStand = false
	end
	
	local function startFlying()
		local rootPart = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		if not rootPart then return end
	
		saveTransparency()
		setTransparency(0.5)
	
		local flySpeed = 50
		local currentVelocity = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
		local targetVelocity = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
	
		humanoid.PlatformStand = true
	
		local hoverPosition = rootPart.Position
	
		flightConnection = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(delta)
			if not rootPart or not rootPart.Parent then
				stopFlying()
				return
			end
	
			local inputDirection = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
	
			if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.S) then
				inputDirection = inputDirection + Vector3.new(0, 0, -1)
			end
			if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.W) then
				inputDirection = inputDirection + Vector3.new(0, 0, 1)
			end
			if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.A) then
				inputDirection = inputDirection + Vector3.new(-1, 0, 0)
			end
			if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.D) then
				inputDirection = inputDirection + Vector3.new(1, 0, 0)
			end
			if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.Space) then
				inputDirection = inputDirection + Vector3.new(0, 1, 0)
			end
			if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.LeftControl) then
				inputDirection = inputDirection + Vector3.new(0, -1, 0)
			end
	
			if inputDirection.Magnitude > 0 then
				local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
				local cameraCFrame = camera.CFrame
	
				local worldDirection = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
				if inputDirection.Z ~= 0 then
					worldDirection = worldDirection + cameraCFrame.LookVector * inputDirection.Z
				end
				if inputDirection.X ~= 0 then
					worldDirection = worldDirection + cameraCFrame.RightVector * inputDirection.X
				end
				if inputDirection.Y ~= 0 then
					worldDirection = worldDirection + Vector3.new(0, inputDirection.Y, 0)
				end
	
				targetVelocity = worldDirection.Unit * flySpeed
			else
				targetVelocity = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
			end
	
			local acceleration = 20
			if targetVelocity.Magnitude > 0 then
				currentVelocity = currentVelocity + (targetVelocity - currentVelocity) * acceleration * delta
			else
				currentVelocity = currentVelocity * (1 - acceleration * delta) 
			end
	
			if currentVelocity.Magnitude > flySpeed then
				currentVelocity = currentVelocity.Unit * flySpeed
			end
	
			if currentVelocity.Magnitude > 0.1 then
				hoverPosition = hoverPosition + currentVelocity * delta

	local UIS = game:GetService("UserInputService")
	function dragify(Frame)
	    dragToggle = nil
	    local dragSpeed = 0
	    dragInput = nil
	    dragStart = nil
	    local dragPos = nil
	    function updateInput(input)
	        local Delta = input.Position - dragStart
	        local Position = UDim2.new(startPos.X.Scale, startPos.X.Offset + Delta.X, startPos.Y.Scale, startPos.Y.Offset + Delta.Y)
	        game:GetService("TweenService"):Create(Frame, TweenInfo.new(0.25), {Position = Position}):Play()

	            dragStart = input.Position
	            startPos = Frame.Position
	            input.Changed:Connect(function()
	                if input.UserInputState == Enum.UserInputState.End then

	                end
	            end)
	        end
	    end)

	            dragInput = input
	        end
	    end)
	    game:GetService("UserInputService").InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
	        if input == dragInput and dragToggle then

	    end)
